guides.title: Pumpdown Timeout
guides.summary: The synthetic chamber pressure did not reach the demo process setpoint before the pumpdown step timed out.

checks.label: Confirm the chamber door/interlock state is closed before retrying pumpdown.
Confirm the vacuum pump command is ON in the HMI or trace log.
Compare the current pressure reading with the expected pumpdown trend.
Check whether the synthetic exhaust path or gate valve state is blocking pumpdown.

choices.label: Door/interlock was not ready
choices.nextAction: Secure the chamber/interlock, reset the demo alarm, and retry pumpdown.

choices.label: Pump command is ON but pressure remains high
choices.nextAction: Export the issue report with pressure snapshot and escalate to engineering review.

choices.label: Pressure reading looks inconsistent
choices.nextAction: Capture the issue report and flag the pressure signal for sensor/IO path review.

escalationConditions: Pump command is ON but chamber pressure does not trend downward.
Pressure value is frozen, out of range, or inconsistent with the expected pumpdown step.
The same pumpdown timeout repeats after interlock reset.

guides.title: Temperature Not Stable
guides.summary: The synthetic wafer temperature did not reach the demo stabilization band before ALD cycles started.

checks.label: Confirm the recipe temperature setpoint shown on the HMI.
Confirm the current wafer temperature reading and whether it is trending toward setpoint.
Confirm the alarm occurred during the temperature stabilization step.

choices.label: Temperature is still ramping
choices.nextAction: Hold the process and review whether the stabilization timeout is too short for this demo recipe.

choices.label: Temperature value is flat or unrealistic
choices.nextAction: Export the issue report and review the synthetic sensor or trace generation path.

choices.label: Setpoint and reading look normal after reset
choices.nextAction: Reset the demo alarm and retry the normal process timeline.

escalationConditions: Temperature does not move toward the setpoint during stabilization.
Temperature jumps abruptly without a matching process state change.
The same stabilization alarm repeats after a retry.

guides.title: Gas Delivery Step Timeout
guides.summary: A synthetic precursor, reactant, or purge step failed to complete within the demo process timing rule.

checks.label: Confirm which valve or gas delivery step was active when the alarm occurred.
Confirm the ALD cycle number shown in the HMI and report.
Check whether chamber pressure changed as expected during the gas delivery step.
Confirm the active recipe step matches the expected ALD dose/purge sequence.

choices.label: Expected valve was not active
choices.nextAction: Capture the issue report and review command-to-valve mapping in the sequence logic.

choices.label: Valve active but process response missing
choices.nextAction: Escalate with the process snapshot, active valve state, and trace log.

choices.label: State looks normal after reset
choices.nextAction: Reset the demo alarm and rerun the fault scenario or normal timeline for comparison.

escalationConditions: Valve state does not match the active ALD step.
Gas delivery step fails repeatedly on the same cycle.
Pressure or film trend is inconsistent with the active dose/purge step.

guides.title: Sequence State Mismatch
guides.summary: The synthetic process reached an unexpected sequence state or a generic step-level fault without a more specific guide.

checks.label: Confirm the current process state and the last accepted operator command.
Confirm the previous successful step before the mismatch.
Review the engineering trace for the first rejected or failed transition.

choices.label: Mismatch followed an operator command
choices.nextAction: Record the command and state snapshot, then review whether the command should be blocked earlier in the HMI.

choices.label: Cause is not clear from the HMI
choices.nextAction: Export the issue report and escalate with trace, current state, and previous step.

escalationConditions: The same sequence mismatch is reproducible.
The HMI allows an operation that should be blocked by the current state.
The engineering trace shows a rejected transition that is not explained by the guide.
